reason: Ivory Coast international winger, Bundesliga Rookie of the Season 2025/26 with RB Leipzig, signed for Real Madrid on 6 August 2026. Eight opened sources including one league source; the Real Madrid and RB Leipzig pages could not be opened in full.

gapNote: The Real Madrid and RB Leipzig official pages returned errors when opened, so the club statements are not quoted directly; the signing is taken from beIN Sports and Irish News, which cite the club. Transfer fees differ by outlet (Press Association GBP 115.8m, IANS EUR 130m, Spanish media EUR 140m including bonuses), so the page should leave the fee out or attribute a single figure to its outlet and date. Season figures differ between sources (12 goals and 8 assists in 33 league matches per Bundesliga/Africa Soccer). The page can add the Leipzig move, the Ivory Coast World Cup debut at 19 years and 212 days, and the Bundesliga award, which current top results do not all cover.
